standard-accrued-rights.heading: Term and Termination
paragraphs: The expiry or termination of this Agreement does not affect any rights, remedies, obligations or liabilities of the parties that have accrued before it takes effect.

standard-duration.heading: Duration
paragraphs: Termination or expiry of this Agreement shall not release the Receiving Party from liability for any breach of this Agreement committed before it takes effect.
